name: Ig2_GridNode_GridNode_GridNodeGeom6D
description: Create/update a GridNodeGeom6D instance representing the geometry of a contact point between two GridNode<GridNode>, including relative rotations.

attributes.name: avoidGranularRatcheting
attributes.description: Define relative velocity so that ratcheting is avoided. It applies for sphere-sphere contacts. It eventualy also apply for sphere-emulating interactions (i.e. convertible into the ScGeom type), if the virtual sphere's motion is defined correctly (see e.g.

attributes.name: creep
attributes.description: Substract rotational creep from relative rotation. The rotational creep

attributes.name: interactionDetectionFactor
attributes.description:
Enlarge both radii by this factor (if >1), to permit creation of distant interactions.

InteractionGeometry will be computed when interactionDetectionFactor*(rad1+rad2) > distance.

.. note::
	 This parameter is functionally coupled with

attributes.name: updateRotations
attributes.description: Precompute relative rotations. Turning this false can speed up simulations when rotations are not needed in constitutive laws (e.g. when spheres are compressed without cohesion and moment in early stage of a triaxial test), but is not foolproof. Change this value only if you know what you are doing.
